title: Workforce Cost-per-Outcome Ladder
description: Enter program costs, enrollment, placements, retention, and wage data for up to three programs to produce the full DOL TEGL 6-13 cost ladder (Cost per Participant, Cost per Employed Exiter, Cost per Retained Employee, Cost per Individual with Earnings Increase) plus Cost per Employed Day, benchmark flags against the Massachusetts $7,500 outcome cap and the ~$26/day national CPED benchmark, and a side-by-side multi-program comparison with a funder-facing one-pager.
data_vintage: DOL ETA TEGL 6-13 cost ladder definitions (statutory framework, changes on TEGL revision cycles); Massachusetts workforce RFP $7,500-per-employment-outcome benchmark; ~$26/employed-day national CPED benchmark (Generation cost-per-employed-day proposal). All benchmark figures are user-overridable.
regulatory_citations: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration — TEGL 6-13, WIOA Cost Ladder Performance Measures
Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA), Public Law 113-128, enacted July 22, 2014
